join hortbot 999 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !list restrict <name> everyone|regulars|subs|vips|mods|broadcaster|admin


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict mylist all
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' does not exist.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict mylist what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !list restrict <name> everyone|regulars|subs|vips|mods|broadcaster|admin

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist restrict huh
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mylist restrict everyone|regulars|subs|vips|mods|broadcaster|admin


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' is restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist restrict
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' is restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict mylist all
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' restricted to everyone and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist restrict
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' is restricted to everyone and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist restrict mods
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' restricted to moderators and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' is restricted to moderators and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist restrict broadcaster
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' restricted to broadcasters and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=moderator :!mylist restrict mods
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=moderator :!list restrict mylist mods
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Your level is moderator; you cannot restrict a list with level broadcaster.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict mylist admin
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Your level is broadcaster; you cannot restrict a list to level admin.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist restrict admin
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Your level is broadcaster; you cannot restrict a list to level admin.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict mylist subs
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' restricted to subscribers and above.
